command: kubectl get deployment -n geo-ddb3 tiles -o yaml
kubectl get service -n geo-ddb3 tiles -o yaml
kubectl create -f tiles.yaml -n geo-ddb3 --dry-run=client -o yaml | sed 's/^metadata:/&\n  namespace: geo-ddb3/' | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl get deployment tiles -n geo-ddb3 -o yaml | grep -v "resourceVersion\|uid\|generation\|creationTimestamp" > /tmp/tiles-backup.yaml && cat /tmp/tiles-backup.yaml

cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f - -n geo-ddb3
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tiles-new
  labels:
    app: tiles
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: tiles
      scheme: v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: tiles
        scheme: v2
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: tiles
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - sleep 6; touch /tmp/ready; exec httpd -f -p 8080
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 64Mi
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - test
            - -f
            - /tmp/ready
          periodSeconds: 1
          failureThreshold: 1
EOF
kubectl get deployment tiles-new -n geo-ddb3 -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - -n geo-ddb3 -o yaml | grep name
